title: arrhenatherum pratense
intro: Arrhenatherum pratense, commonly known as meadow oat-grass, is a perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving menstrual cramps, and calming the nervous system. The health benefits of Arrhenatherum pratense include its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative effects.
